map_control.limitations: Printed city map, not cadastral survey.18.67m is fit-control training RMSE;15.62m is independent reserved-intersection RMSE; neither measures actual1871bank or building accuracy. Historical street continuity, engraved line widths and modern widening remain limitations. Fullerton–31st,Western–lake coverage; west/south extensions are reconstructed.

uncertainties.registration: Observed8heldout RMSE15.62m/max25.65m;28fitLOO21.49m. Whole-district holdout RMSE13.5–28.4m. Use30m as a planning allowance within mapped coverage, not a statistical confidence bound.
uncertainties.pixel_reading: Typically1.5–2pixels (about6–8m) for manual street-centre picks. Raster geometry, engraved line width and original surveying remain independent limits.
uncertainties.modern_target_continuity: Modern intersections may have widened or shifted since1870. CRS audit finds<0.006m rounding-only discrepancy, but this does not establish historic centreline identity.
uncertainties.map_feature_generalization: Bank widths, rail/shore envelopes and park edges retain roughly40–80m context allowance. Georegistration residuals do not establish actual1871bank accuracy.
uncertainties.outside_mapped_coverage: West ofWestern and south of31st are editorial reconstruction, allowance150–300m or greater, not validated map interpolation.

statistic_labels.held_out_rms_m: 8reserved controls excluded from fit, model selection and geometry anchors
statistic_labels.leave_one_out_rms_m: resampling of28fit controls; not the separate reserve test

map_control.late_feature_reading_note: Bridge approaches, adjacent channel bends and Lake Park lagoon/Illinois Central topology were re-read after the global registration audit. The 28 fit / 8 reserved control split and transform are unchanged. See the subsequent reading corrections in the reprojection audit.

boundary_evidence.liberties: Generalized stepped outline: Fullerton east of Western; North Avenue west to Fortieth; canal southwest boundary; Western south to Egan; Egan east to the lake. Not a surveyed legal polygon. The proposed Jefferson addition is excluded. Western/southern vertices are an unchanged editorial ENU reconstruction; only the map-derived lake edge is reprojected. The northern limit is generalized at scene scale, not a surveyed Fullerton right-of-way.

shoreline_evidence.liberties: Outer water, railway and land edge generalized from the 1870 map. Tips are extrapolated to the scene extent. The Lake Park lagoon remains water; modern Grant Park landfill is excluded.

rivers.liberties: Centerline manually read from Mitchell 1870. Channel width is reconstructed at 52–65 m, compared with reported 153–190 ft downtown bridge lengths. Printed water width is exaggerated; this is not surveyed bank geometry.
rivers.raster_reading_note: Retained the generalized main-stem course while inserting the freshly read Wells, Clark and State crossing centres. Channel width remains reconstructed separately.

rivers.liberties: Centerline manually read from Mitchell 1870. Channel width is reconstructed at 52–65 m, compared with reported 153–190 ft downtown bridge lengths. Printed water width is exaggerated; this is not surveyed bank geometry.
rivers.raster_reading_note: Independent review corrected the west Goose Island channel: the old point[835,865] was on an east-bank street block. Retained mapped junctions with the separately traced east canal; no modern geometry is used.

rivers.liberties: Centerline manually read from Mitchell 1870. Channel width is reconstructed at 52–65 m, compared with reported 153–190 ft downtown bridge lengths. Printed water width is exaggerated; this is not surveyed bank geometry.
rivers.raster_reading_note: Independent review corrected the Fifteenth Street bend: old point[1350,2030] was east-bank roadway, while[1294,1940] was on the west bank. New points follow the visible channel centre.

rivers.liberties: Printed South Fork centreline traced through Thirty-first Street; width is reconstructed. Its continuation beyond the sheet is stored separately as an explicit editorial extension.
rivers.raster_reading_note: Traced the printed South Fork east of Reuben/Ashland to Thirty-first Street. Its former editorial course began at the wrong crossing and overlapped Ashland. In-map and out-of-map portions are now separate records.

rivers.liberties: Mapped canal centreline only; width is reconstructed. The outer municipal continuation is stored separately.
rivers.raster_reading_note: Traced the separately labeled Illinois and Michigan Canal southwest from its South Fork junction to the map edge. It does not begin at Reuben bridge.

rivers.name: West Branch of the South Branch
rivers.liberties: Channel centreline follows the map label W. Br. of So. Branch. Width remains reconstructed. The trace stops at Western Avenue, the sheet edge; its western continuation is unresolved. The Board report explicitly places Reuben Street bridge on this west fork.
rivers.raster_reading_note: Freshly traced the distinct West Branch through Reuben crossing to the map edge. This channel had incorrectly been conflated with the South Fork and canal.

rivers.liberties: Straight continuation beyond Thirty-first Street using the last mapped reach heading. This is a declared reconstruction, not an observed 1871 course or bank survey. Positional allowance is 150–300 m or greater.
Retains the declared western/southern editorial canal continuation beyond the Mitchell sheet, joined to the correct mapped canal exit. Not an engineering survey.

rivers.name: North Branch Canal east of Goose Island
rivers.liberties: The distinct east channel is visibly drawn on Mitchell 1870. Its centreline is traced; width is reconstructed. Its unconfirmed Halsted crossing is not automatically bridged.
rivers.raster_reading_note: Independent review restored the visibly separate east Goose Island canal. Omitting this water previously joined the island to the mainland.

water_polygons.liberties: Retains the prefill lagoon between Michigan Avenue and the Illinois Central railway. Generalized water envelope; depot fill north of Randolph is separate.
water_polygons.raster_reading_note: Re-read the water between Lake Park and the Illinois Central embankment. East water bank is near pixel 1519, track centre near 1523 and outer lake edge near 1534; these distinct printed lines were previously conflated. Southern lagoon tapers closed near Park Place (pixel y1853), before Twelfth Street. Widths remain small-scale map interpretation, not an engineering survey.

exclusions.name: October7–8SaturdayNightFire damage context
exclusions.liberties: Uncertainty exclusion within the broad South Branch / Van Buren / Clinton / Adams bounds reported by the museum timeline. The area was already damaged on October 8 afternoon. This is not a parcel-level survival mask and does not depict the later Great Fire.
exclusions.source_role: Map controls the alignment only; the linked museum account supplies factual fire context.

liberties: Generic lot shapes, occupancy classes, heights and details are district-based reconstruction, not invented historical identities.
Pavement choices and sidewalk continuity are editorial defaults. Municipal work footage does not prove a full corridor was continuously improved.
Late-afternoon time is an editorial scene choice. Local mean solar time precedes standardized time.
This plan does not attest exact people, vehicles, tree positions, weather or individual facades.
Initial city context foundation; it does not establish photographic accuracy or a complete building inventory.

Map registration uses28fit controls and8reserved checks. Improved registration does not convert generic lots, park/shore traces, bridge forms or outlying districts into surveyed historical geometry. Modern State/Madison grid anchor remains an explicit reconstruction convention; mapped roads are not forced onto it.
The northwestern_north_branch railway remains a coarse corridor with incompletely resolved bends. It must not be presented as surveyed engineering track geometry.
